title: Pinning the deploy tool every product depends on.
description: shipper runs with production credentials in every product. How we stopped its v1 tag moving on its own and pinned callers to exact commits.
lede: Every ideaSquared product deploys through shipper, and shipper runs with the Cloudflare token in reach. So who can change shipper, and how fast that change reaches production, is a design question. We changed our answer between 14 and 22 November.
summary: v1 used to move after every green merge. Now it moves only through an approved release, and products pin shipper to an exact commit. This is how we got there.
